content.name: Digital Bible Library AI Bible Data Hub

attributes.description: A page that lists open-access Bible text, audio, video and braille entries for use in AI modelling.
attributes.how_to_use: Open the text and audio open-access lists and look for Lamnso' (lns). Read the licence shown on the individual entry, because the hub's general statement says open access but each entry has its own copyright holder.
attributes.status_for_lamnso: Not checked whether Lamnso' is listed.

source.citation: API.Bible support article, What if I want to train AI with a copyright Bible? Compiled for this collection and not yet reviewed by a second person.

content.name: API.Bible policy on training AI with copyrighted Bibles

attributes.rule: Bible content accessed through API.Bible cannot be used to train, fine-tune or improve generative AI models without explicit written permission from both API.Bible and the copyright holder.
attributes.amount: The rule applies however little text is used.
attributes.allowed: Displaying Scripture in an app through the API, without training a model, may be allowed depending on the licence.
attributes.lesson: Ask the copyright holder for permission before training, and keep any permission in writing.

source.citation: Hugging Face model cards and documentation for MMS, InfoQ's report on the release, and the CC BY-NC 4.0 licence discussion on Hugging Face. Compiled for this collection and not yet reviewed by a second person.

attributes.asr: mms-1b-all is a speech recognition model for 1,162 languages built on wav2vec 2.0, with a small adapter of about 2 million parameters for each language.
attributes.tts: A separate speech synthesis checkpoint exists for each of more than 1,100 languages, in the form facebook/mms-tts followed by the language code.
attributes.training_data: Fine-tuned on Bible readings in 1,107 languages, with an average of 32 hours of audio per language.
attributes.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0, which means noncommercial. Fine for research and prototypes, not for a commercial product.
attributes.check_lamnso: Check whether lns is in the supported language list before planning around it.

source.citation: Wycliffe, That's what good tools do, and Wycliffe Associates' AI page. Compiled for this collection and not yet reviewed by a second person.

content.name: SIL and Wycliffe AI work on Bible translation

attributes.description: SIL's AI team uses tools called Slingshot, Serval and Scripture Forge to help produce translation drafts that language communities then check.
attributes.finding: SIL reports that a small amount of excellent data, such as a thoroughly checked New Testament, can produce useful drafts of other Scripture portions.
attributes.principles: Wycliffe Associates published ethical principles for church-owned use of AI in Bible translation in 2025.
attributes.value: Natural partners for a Lamnso' project, since the Lamnso' Bible was translated with Wycliffe-linked organisations.
